ledger_interpretation.aggregation: four bilinear corners weighted per point; levels/timesteps are scanned without averaging or pooling points
ledger_interpretation.between_identity: D_entry(t+1)-D_return(t); net between-call change from every non-KDM6 operation, not pure transport
ledger_interpretation.same_call_residual_roundoff_model: gamma8 bound on eight binary64 operations: gamma8*(|OLD_entry|+|FIX_entry|+|OLD_return|+|FIX_return|); zero scale requires zero residual
ledger_interpretation.ulp_scale: incoming/within use ULP of OLD entry REAL32 state; between uses ULP of OLD return REAL32 state; relative differences use the same old state value as denominator

scope: native state-path evidence; no predictive-skill attribution
